controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.summary: The vendor maintains a documented information security policy, approved by leadership and communicated to relevant personnel.
controls.validationGuidance: Confirm the policy is reviewed periodically, not a static one-time document.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.summary: The vendor maintains an inventory of information assets and their owners.
controls.validationGuidance: Ask for evidence the inventory is kept current, not just that one exists.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.summary: The vendor manages information security risks associated with its own suppliers and subcontractors.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for a defined process, not a one-off contractual clause.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.summary: The vendor has a planned and tested approach to managing information security incidents.
controls.validationGuidance: Ask for evidence of a recent tabletop exercise or real incident response.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.summary: Personnel receive appropriate information security training relevant to their role.
controls.validationGuidance: Role-specific training (e.g. for engineers vs. general staff) is stronger evidence than a single generic module.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.summary: The vendor has a defined process for revoking access and responsibilities when personnel leave or change roles.
controls.validationGuidance: Confirm access revocation timing (e.g. same-day) is specified.

controls.title: Physical entry controls
controls.summary: Physical access to facilities housing sensitive systems is controlled and monitored.
controls.validationGuidance: Lower priority for fully cloud-hosted vendors with no physical facilities in scope.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.summary: Storage media containing sensitive information is handled, transported, and disposed of securely.
controls.validationGuidance: Ask about secure disposal/destruction procedures specifically, not just storage handling.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.summary: Configurations of hardware, software, and network systems are established, documented, and monitored for unauthorized changes.
controls.validationGuidance: Look for configuration baselines and drift detection, not just initial setup documentation.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.summary: Networks, systems, and applications are monitored for anomalous behavior and potential security events.
controls.validationGuidance: Confirm active monitoring exists, not only log retention without active review.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.summary: The vendor has rules for the effective use of cryptography, including encryption of sensitive data in transit and at rest.
controls.validationGuidance: Ask for specific standards used (e.g. TLS 1.2+, AES-256), not a general encryption claim.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.summary: Secure coding principles are applied to software development, including code review and vulnerability testing.
controls.validationGuidance: Relevant primarily for vendors that develop custom software - lower priority for pure infrastructure/hosting vendors.
